Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Non-obese (BMI < 30)
  -  Non-smokers
  -  Free of any systemic diseases including hypertension, [OR]  diabetes, [OR]  coronary artery disease, [OR]  neurologic disease, [OR]  or any other major medical co-morbidity
  -  Women will be either surgically sterilized  [OR] or non-pregnant as determined by a urine pregnancy test
